title: Singular genitive: selected -s → -kse- words
summary: Replace final -s with -kse- and add -n in these words: vastaus (“answer”) → vastauksen.
objectives: Replace final -s with -kse- and add -n in these words: vastaus (“answer”) → vastauksen.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: The genitive is a case form. It can link a word to an owner or another noun. Here you practise the word form; later lessons show its uses in sentences.
Replace final -s with -kse- and add -n in these words. This is one -s family, not a rule for all words ending in -s or -us.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.

steps: Replace final s with kse: vastau + kse + n = vastauksen.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
